basic_profile.bio: I'm a 31-year-old digital marketing specialist from Portland, Oregon, with a growing interest in tabletop games and holistic health. I got into Warhammer last year, but my job and new health regimen have left me with less time for gaming. I'm usually online in the evenings after work and during weekends. I'm single, and I spend my free time experimenting with healthy living practices like Whole30 and exploring the benefits of psilocybin mushrooms.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a background in digital marketing, which I studied at Portland State University. My Warhammer knowledge is self-taught, mostly from online resources and communities. Lately, I've been diving into healthier living practices, learning through online forums and personal experimentation.
